name: New Jersey Appellate Division
court: Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division
source_note: Rule numbers and day counts are a deadline table, not legal advice. Confirm the current New Jersey Court Rules before relying on a date. This pack never files or serves.

deadlines.label: Motion for reconsideration in the Appellate Division
deadlines.notes: Within 10 days of the date of entry of the judgment or order. The time may be enlarged under R. 1:3-4(a).

deadlines.label: Motion in the appellate court
deadlines.notes: Governs form and service of motions in the Appellate Division. Use the deadline that belongs to the relief requested.

deadlines.label: Motion to alter or amend a trial-court judgment
deadlines.notes: Not later than 20 days after service of the judgment. Trial-level clock.

deadlines.label: Enlargement of time
deadlines.notes: The court may enlarge the time for taking action except where a rule says the time may not be enlarged.

deadlines.label: Stay pending appeal (motion)
deadlines.notes: Stay practice is motion-driven. Confirm the current rule text before using a date.

deadlines.label: Tolling of time to appeal
deadlines.notes: A timely motion of the listed kinds tolls the time for appeal until entry of the order deciding the motion. Confirm the current list of tolling motions.
